name: Anupa Siriwardana
headline: Building reliable backends and on‑chain systems.
about: I’m a final year Software Engineering undergraduate at the University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC). I enjoy turning ideas into reliable, well structured software, and my main focus is the backend: designing APIs, modelling data, and thinking about how systems stay consistent and secure as they grow.

My internship gave me hands-on experience with production systems and working in an agile team alongside engineers and QA. Beyond that, I’m interested in how financial systems can run on-chain, while my final year research looks at how object detection models can be attacked and defended.
